result:
Round 242 passes: A's fix works in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720. I also found one open Medium bug that the earlier fix doesn't cover; it existed before this round and B needs to schedule it.

**The C-R241-01 fix holds.** I Tabbed to the Snap toggle (30 Tabs), right-clicked an empty point on the lane, then closed the menu three ways: Escape, choosing `0.5 s`, and choosing `Narrow`. Each time the menu closed, the choice was applied, and focus went back to the Snap toggle instead of the page body.
- After Escape the brass focus ring is drawn on screen, not just set in CSS: the toggle crop has 103 brass pixels against 17 after a mouse choice, when the ring is correctly hidden.
- The same result holds on an empty point of the music lane and on a clip body with the 120 BPM demo seeded.

**Every other acceptance row passed:**
- **Scope:** the code is round 241's file plus B's three changes, byte for byte. The 1,101 frozen files, the root files and the 7 auth/purchase files are unchanged.
- **Unit tests:** all 61 files in the covering set pass, 1,077 tests in total, including the four new ones (GM36–GM39).
- **Mutants:** removing the right-press capture turns GM36, GM37 and GM39 red; letting the press-time element always win turns GM38 red. The repo is unchanged afterwards.
- **Neighbouring behaviour:** a second right-click moves the menu and Escape still returns focus to the toggle. Clicking Play with the menu open only closes it. Choosing `0.25 s` during playback keeps it playing with sound. Right-clicking a track header opens no grid menu. Left-dragging on a lane still draws the selection box and selects the clip.
- **Round 241 features, menu content and screen text:** the menu groups, the `4` Snap key and the grid-division description are as in round 241, and the visible text line counts match it.
- **Doc 186:** all seven required edits are present.
- **Playback and export:** Space plays and pauses, and the exported WAV is 16.000 s, 48 kHz, 24-bit, stereo with no NaN samples. Its sha256 matches rounds 237–241.
- **Auth:** a fresh, signed-out context opens `/studio-lab` with no stored user. `/studio/middle-east` still asks for sign-in and loads no audio, and the token endpoint returns 401 without a header.

**Open bug, C-R242-01 (Medium).** If a track Volume fader has keyboard focus and you right-click the lane, then press Escape, focus ends on the page body. This confirms A's code-review finding (A-R242-REVIEW-M1), which had only been read from source.
- **Cause:** a separate timeline handler drops focus from sliders and text fields on any mouse press, including a right-click. It runs before the fix gets a chance to record where focus was.
- **Origin:** that handler is frozen and unchanged since round 241, so this round didn't cause it.
- **Ruling needed from B:** either a right-click skips that focus release, or focus returns to the released control.
- **Not measured:** typing fields, loop braces and markers probably behave the same, but I only tested a fader. I also didn't reproduce it on the published code in the browser.

**Not run here:**
- The purchased-copy check is blocked because there is no backend in the cloud.
- The full test suite, build, lint, typecheck, `verify` and e2e smoke are left to the root gate.
- Doc 186 has no saved round-241 copy, so I can confirm the seven edits are there but can't prove nothing else changed in it.

The JSON has `browserVerified` and `realVerified` set to true and includes the env status. The repo is unchanged by my run.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-242.md
- c-round-242.json
- c-round-242/c242.cjs
- c-round-242/ring-pixels.cjs
